```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r data}

data("BCI")
diversity(BCI,index = "shannon")
SOLACE <- read_csv("Results/IN2020_V08_CatchComp.csv")
```

```{r diversity}
solace_spwide <- SOLACE %>% 
  select(Site,daylight,Depth_Stratum,Deployment, Taxa_updated,nos) %>% 
  complete(Taxa_updated = levels(Taxa_updated), fill=list(nos=0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Taxa_updated, values_from = nos)

 We can use complete to create the combination bassed on the levels and then use pivot_wider

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
df %>% 
  complete(color = levels(color), fill = list(nb = 0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = nb)
  

```
